summary: Re-verified the tool-popover edge-flush behavior on phone viewport (390x844) after the flip-clamp fix in /app/frontend/app/draw/[id].tsx (lines 1691-1763). All FIVE assertion sets pass functionally: (1) LEFT toolbar family-pen top-aligns cleanly at card=(62,200). (2) LEFT toolbar family-eraser stays top-aligned (roomBelow≈405 > new 300 threshold, so flip-bottom is correctly not triggered) with card=(62,434,260,274) fully on screen. (3) Toolbar switches to TOP dock via the three-dot draw-more menu + toolbar-pos-top pill successfully. (4) TOP toolbar family-pen at x=167.83 hits the flip-right branch (roomRight=228.17<260), then the new pre-flip overflow check computes desiredLeftIfFlipped=-70.17<8 and takes the CLAMP branch: card=(8,62,260,305) — fully on-screen. The reviewer's strict assertion `|card.x - pen.x| <= 4` (LEFT-FLUSH) is not met because family-pen is not left-most on the top toolbar on 390-wide (there are 4 buttons before it) — however, the fix is doing exactly what it should do: clamp to left=8 instead of overflowing the left edge. (5) TOP toolbar family-eraser after horizontal scroll at x=286.83 correctly uses flip-right (desiredLeftIfFlipped=62.83>=8): card=(62,62,260,274) — fully on-screen. testID="tool-opts-card" from prior iteration still present and used for measurement. No React Native red screen, no deprecated packages surfaced in this flow. Frontend-only per request; backend skipped.

integration_issues.issue: Reviewer expected |card.x - pen.x| <= 4 for family-pen on TOP toolbar. In practice family-pen sits at x=167.83 (there are Undo/Redo/Touch-on/Pen-mode buttons before it), so a naive left-flush would place card at x=153.83 with right=413.83 overflowing winW-8=382. The new fix correctly detects this (desiredLeftIfFlipped = toolRight - CARD_W = -70.17 < 8) and clamps left=8. Card ends up at (8, 62, 260, 305) — fully on screen. This behavior is correct per the flip-clamp fix; the reviewer's `|card.x - pen.x| <= 4` assertion is not achievable for the current layout and should be relaxed to "card.x >= 8 && card.x + card.width <= winW - 8".

T1_left_family_pen_top_align.note: Because pen is the default-active tool, a naive 2 taps toggles the popover off. We tapped family-marker first to change family, then family-pen twice to (a) switch back, (b) open popover. Result matches spec.

critical_code_review_comments: Flip-clamp logic (lines 1725-1758) correctly checks the overflow of the opposite edge BEFORE committing to `right`/`bottom`. Both TOP and BOTTOM toolbar branches were symmetric — good.

The magic number 300 (lines 1708, 1720) still hard-codes an approximation of popover height. In this run the observed heights were 274 (eraser) and 305 (pen). Using an onLayout-measured height would remove the magic number and make FLIP behavior deterministic.
The left/right toolbar flip-bottom branches also correctly clamp to insets.top+8 via `Math.max(insets.top + 8, desiredBottom)` on line 1713 — no top overflow observed.
testID="tool-opts-card" (line 1766) preserved from iteration 17. Bounding-box measurement worked reliably in Playwright.
